title: The dictionaries are suing OpenAI for 'massive’ copyright infringement, saying ChatGPT eats revenue | Fortune
summary: Britannica and Merriam-Webster sue OpenAI for copyright infringement, claiming ChatGPT uses their content and harms publishers' revenue. The case questions AI use of public knowledge and copyright boundaries.
sentiment_reason: The lawsuit alleges negative impact on publishers' revenue and copyright infringement, suggesting a negative market sentiment due to potential legal and financial consequences for OpenAI.
